interview:
I won! 🎉

Here's what happened: I typed the name "Player" and started the game. Le Chonk the cat began in the bottom-left corner, the fish was in the top-right corner, and the guard dog started in the center of the 7×7 board.

My winning strategy was simple and effective: I moved the cat **right along the bottom row** (which was completely free of obstacles) until reaching the bottom-right corner, then moved **straight up the rightmost column** to the fish. That column was also obstacle-free, and since the dog could only step one square per turn toward the cat, it always trailed 2–3 squares behind — it never got close enough to catch Le Chonk.

The game ended with the message **"Le Chonk got the fish! 🐟"** in just **12 moves**, with the cat safely on the fish square and the dog still far behind at row 4. A "Play again" button is now showing, but the goal was achieved — the heist was a success!
